## README.md
# Global Mangrove Watch v4.1.12

![Mangrove](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mangrove-blue) ![Landsat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Landsat-blue) ![Sentinel-2](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sentinel--2-blue) ![ALOS PALSAR](https://img.shields.io/badge/ALOS_PALSAR-blue) ![JERS-1](https://img.shields.io/badge/JERS--1-blue) ![ALOS-2 PALSAR-2](https://img.shields.io/badge/ALOS--2_PALSAR--2-blue) ![Global Mangrove Watch](https://img.shields.io/badge/Global_Mangrove_Watch-blue)

A mirror of the [Global Mangrove Watch](https://www.globalmangrovewatch.org) v4.1.12 timeseries of mangrove extent, 1985 to 2025, published on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/21346457) by Bunting et al. (2026). The catalog holds the annual extent as cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs and as GeoParquet partitioned by year, change against the 1985, 1990, 2000, and 2010 baselines, the union and intersection of all years, and per-country area statistics. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before you query.

## Source

[https://zenodo.org/records/21346457](https://zenodo.org/records/21346457)

## Processing Notes

Downloaded all 55 files of Zenodo record 21346457 (v4.1.12, published 2026-07-13) on 2026-11-20 and verified each against its Zenodo MD5 checksum. The rasters were delivered as 1,696 one-degree GeoTIFF tiles per product in tar.gz archives. Each band of each product was mosaicked into one global COG (EPSG:4326, 0.000269469° pixels, DEFLATE, 512 px tiles, nearest-neighbour overviews, embedded statistics and color table). No pixel value was changed. The intersect tiles were stored as Int64 and are written as Byte. The vectors were delivered as gzipped GeoPackages and are written as GeoParquet 2.0 in the source CRS (EPSG:4326), Hilbert-ordered, with the GeoPackage feature id dropped. The country statistics were delivered as one workbook and 1,016 matrix files (Parquet and duplicate xlsx), and are reshaped into two long-format tables. The collection thumbnails are rendered from the COGs over the Esri World Light Gray Canvas basemap (Esri, HERE, Garmin, © OpenStreetMap contributors, and the GIS user community). The build scripts are in [the repository](https://github.com/nlebovits/global-mangrove-watch).
